title: Microsoft 365 disruption persists as service recovery progresses
dek: Microsoft’s status page continued to show degradations affecting Microsoft 365 and Outlook on Tuesday, even as conditions improved.
socialCaption: Microsoft 365 and Outlook were still showing service degradation Tuesday, though Microsoft said conditions were improving. The key operational distinction: improvement is not full restoration. Teams should keep monitoring official status updates and validate critical workflows before closing the incident.
